name: Petrify Stare
doc: Petrify Stare (the Glacial Eye's (enemy attack 19)): one target task, on the first action's target (its pool holds one): a "stare" layout at the caster's effect point (followed for 10 ticks), ahead of its facing; from tick 14 a "stone" layout on the target; a screen fade; the result at tick 42, the end at 49.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layouts' blended vertex frames (after the target node).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts the target task of the first action (its pool holds one); its clock: the sound, the screen fade, the result, the end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Stare
parts.doc: The layout at the caster's effect point, ahead of its facing

parts.title: Stone
parts.doc: The layout at the target, from a later tick

groups.label: Fade
groups.doc: The engine's screen fade's four values

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its drawing depth: (Base - the caster's size word) >> Shift

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its drawing depth: (Base - the target's size word) >> Shift

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the caster's default position when the target tick == this

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The target task ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Fade tick
params.doc: The engine's screen fade starts when the target tick == this

params.label: Bone
params.doc: The caster's effect point the stare is at (0xF0 and up: the engine's named points)

params.label: Follow until
params.doc: The stare follows that point while the target tick is below this, then stays

params.label: Ahead
params.doc: Moved ahead of the caster's facing by the unit circle (4096) >> this

params.label: From tick
params.doc: The stone is drawn from this target tick, at the target's default effect position taken then...

tasks.doc: The first action's: the stare at the caster's effect point (taken while the tick is below 10), ahead of its facing, its depth from the caster's size; from tick 14 the stone at the target's default effect position (taken then), its depth from the target's size; both through the anchor callback (record flags 0x200: the anchor through the camera + the offset as is; 0x400: angles in ZYX order (0x701430)); the screen fade, the sound at the caster, the result; the end.
